title: Integrate CEGAR semantic paging

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 CEGAR semantic-paging capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: The current accelerator head already contains two separately versioned reusable authorities: CounterexampleGuidedProofDevelopment@1 is a bounded verifier-backed CEGAR loop, and DecisionContextCompiler.expand_decision_context is a deterministic CID-bound semantic paging service. The exact current tree has no adapter that binds a CEGAR counterexample/refinement iteration to an expansion request, no dedicated joint integration test, and no canonical PCSM current-source-map CID for exact file/node/span input. The exact-output authority permits only this receipt, so no competing adapter, source-map authority, or untested wiring was created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The reusable components and their direct positive/negative tests are current-head and passed under the sealed test environment, but their independent availability is not evidence of an integrated CEGAR semantic-paging execution. A PCSM source-map-bound request/result, joint adapter contract, joint test, and aggregate current-PCSM SourceLinkReceipt/source-map CID are unavailable. This receipt therefore records a typed honest non-promotion rather than manufacture a CID, expansion, proof, integration, or promotion claim.

freshness_check.method: Compared outer HEAD and HEAD^{tree}, accelerator HEAD and HEAD^{tree}, and checked outer/admitted worktree porcelain before the receipt write; recorded selected implementation/test Git blobs and SHA-256 values; searched accelerator implementation and PCSM test roots for canonical SourceMap/SourceLink identities and direct CEGAR-to-DecisionContext integration; and ran the required and focused tests under the prescribed PATH, Python 3.12, and fresh private HOME/XDG directories.
freshness_check.result: The dispatch commit equals outer HEAD, every recorded gitlink commit/tree pair equals its checked-out head, and inspected worktrees were clean. The search found neither a PCSM aggregate SourceLinkReceipt/source-map CID nor a direct CounterexampleGuidedProofDevelopment-to-DecisionContext adapter. Git trees, blobs, semantic-node IDs, and generic repository/tree bindings are retained as freshness evidence but are not substituted for the missing PCSM source-map contract.
freshness_check.invalidates_on: Any change to a bound commit/tree, gitlink head/tree, scheduler digest, listed source/test digest, CEGAR/paging contract version, required-test result, joint adapter/test, or PCSM source-map capability requires a fresh receipt.

pcsm_source_map.reason: No current-tree aggregate PCSM SourceLinkReceipt or canonical source-map CID resolves exact PCSM file/node/span identities in the named accelerator implementation/test roots. Git object identities and generic semantic graph roots are not falsely relabelled as this missing contract.

cegar_loop.role: A bounded CEGIS/CEGAR loop that normalizes/replays a counterexample, independently validates a candidate before rerunning the exact originating verifier, binds witness/candidate/tree/goal/verifier/budget/result per iteration, and closes only on a fresh matching verifier receipt. Timeout, disagreement, unavailable, bound change, cancellation, repeated failure, and budget exhaustion remain open, unknown, or typed terminal non-success.

semantic_paging.role: A deterministic semantic-node expansion path that accepts only closure-admitted handles named for the unresolved question, recomputes content identity, checks parent request/context/witness/repository/tree/authority/semantic-root bindings, applies cumulative item/token/byte/latency budgets, rejects repeated requests and drift, and emits a compact retry delta.

integration_status.reason: The sources expose their separate public entry points but do not select one another, define a shared CEGAR semantic-paging schema, or carry a counterexample/refinement-to-expansion CID binding. Reusing both independently cannot honestly be presented as integration.

determinism_and_authority_boundary.binding: CEGAR uses versioned canonical artifacts and a finite CegisBudget whose bound digest is carried in every iteration; closure requires a fresh exact-verifier receipt. Paging derives canonical request/content identities and validates admitted content plus exact parent/repository/tree/authority/semantic-root bindings before emitting a delta.
determinism_and_authority_boundary.boundary: Candidates, model output, a paging request, a retry delta, tests, and solver/verifier transport success are not mutation, proof, completion, or promotion authority. Neither selected component performs M2/M3 mutation, fabricates a source map, or permits an external caller to override authority/freshness.

source_inventory.role: Versioned bounded verifier-backed CEGAR loop, canonical CEGIS contracts, fresh-receipt closure, finite budgets, repeated-failure backoff/termination, and typed non-success outcomes.

positive_coverage: A fresh matching exact-verifier receipt can close a CEGAR witness; canonical loop and iteration artifacts round-trip; fixed budgets terminate; and paging emits a compact question-bound delta that reconstructs its parent while preserving semantic-node identity.

CEGAR binds its witness, candidate, repaired tree/goal, verifier, policy, bound digest, and result; paging binds admitted content and exact parent/repository/tree/authority/semantic-root metadata and applies cumulative budgets.
negative_coverage: Stale/mismatched verifier receipts, invalid independent candidates, unavailable/timeout/disagreement verifiers, bound changes, cancellation, repeated failures, malformed budgets, and non-authority candidates cannot close a CEGAR run.

Unadmitted or cross-boundary handles, repeated or unrelated requests, repository/tree/semantic-root/authority drift, forged retry identities, and count/token/byte/latency budget breaches fail closed in semantic paging.
focused_existing_authority_validation.scope_limit: The 52 tests prove the two existing contracts independently; they are not a joint CEGAR semantic-paging integration test and are not relabelled as one.

limitations: This exact-output dispatch is receipt-only. It does not alter the existing accelerator implementation/tests, create a parallel CEGAR/paging subsystem, or materialize source-map data.
Passing independent CEGAR and paging suites is not evidence that the two services are integrated; the current tree has no direct binding between them.
The absence of a canonical PCSM source-map CID prevents a truthful exact-current-forest paging instance even if a later adapter is added.

No model output, candidate, request, retry delta, test result, or verifier transport response is treated as source mutation, proof, completion, or promotion authority; M2/M3 mutation remains excluded.
This receipt has no immutable self-CID because adding one would change its bytes.
